text: The wooden boat drifted toward reeds. Theo said, “I want the wooden boat.” Mina borrowed the long net. The long net snagged on the willow branch. Mina said, “I need to free the long net.” Theo said, “I can wait.” Mina pushed the long net gently. Mina and Theo walked to the stone outlet. Using the long net, she lifted the wooden boat. She returned the long net to the tool shed. Theo tied the blue cord to the wooden boat. The wooden boat floated on the pond. He held the blue cord.
